en: A sepia-toned postcard showing a grand stone building with a large arched entrance, heavy rusticated lower walls, and classical columns above. Sculptures and decorative reliefs adorn the façade, with a balustraded roofline and a sculptural group on top. People in early 20th‑century clothing walk in front of the building. In white script at the bottom left, the caption reads "The Municipal Art Gallery Bristol."
